# ChainMore

> Cross-Rail Payment Orchestration for merchants whose customers need a familiar checkout across card, bank, and stablecoin rails.

ChainMore turns complex payment flows into one familiar checkout for the customer and one clean merchant record for the business. The public product promise is Web3 payments that feel like Web2 checkout: no gas shown to the customer, no wrong-network confusion, no abandoned crypto flow.

ChainMore is operated by Chainmore OÜ in Tallinn, Estonia. It is non-custodial payment-orchestration middleware; ChainMore does not hold merchant or customer funds.

## Primary Pages

- [Homepage](https://chainmore.io/): product category, customer outcome, and merchant benefit.
- [Pricing](https://chainmore.io/pricing): custom quote posture; no public fixed rate card.

- [Status](https://chainmore.io/status): public operational status.

## What ChainMore Does

- Gives customers a familiar checkout for card, bank, and stablecoin payment methods.
- Lets merchants choose how funds are received: fiat, stablecoin, direct wallet, exchange account, or a configured mix.
- Routes payments across rails according to merchant policy, payment context, live route conditions, and receive preference.
- Keeps blockchain complexity out of the customer-facing payment moment.
- Produces cleaner payment records for finance, support, and operations teams.

## What ChainMore Does Not Claim

- ChainMore is not an acquirer, bank, wallet, or custody provider.
- ChainMore does not publish fixed public pricing. Pricing is custom per merchant flow.
- ChainMore does not claim guaranteed conversion lift, guaranteed savings, or universal zero-chargeback settlement.
- ChainMore does not publicly name pilot customers or restricted-industry targets.

## Commercial Summary

ChainMore quotes the platform layer that removes payment complexity. Provider costs such as PSP fees, bank fees, issuer fees, gas, FX, and other rail costs are passed through at cost unless a signed merchant agreement says otherwise.

## Preferred Short Description

ChainMore is Cross-Rail Payment Orchestration: Web3 payments your customer can actually finish, behind a Web2 checkout that feels like a card payment.
